## Tutorials

The SESSIONPROPERTY() function returns the session settings for a specified option.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT SESSIONPROPERTY('ANSI_NULLS');

---

SESSIONPROPERTY(
option
)
```

## Tutorials

The SYSTEM_USER function returns the login name for the current user.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT SYSTEM_USER;

---

SYSTEM_USER
```

## Tutorials

The USER_NAME() function returns the database user name based on the specified id.

If no id is specified, this function will return the name of the current user.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT USER_NAME();

---

USER_NAME(
id_number
)

---

SELECT USER_NAME(1);
```

## Tutorials

The Asc() function returns the ASCII value for the specific character.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Asc(CustomerName) AS NumCodeOfFirstChar
FROM Customers;

---

Asc(
character
)
```
